priority.source: In Loans!B at the existing sourceRows
priority.behavior: Live formulas display existing repayment priority; lower numbers are repaid first. Loan and Priority use separate B and C cells.

overview.behavior: Amounts and funding statuses link to the source cells. The overview displays Funds Received as Received, with matching total criteria and conditional formatting. Loan labels hyperlink to their source rows. Lenders and debtors occupy their own columns. Repayment labels are mapped to explicit expectations in the overview; source calculations are unchanged. Conditional formatting tracks changing statuses.
overview.layout: Existing overview column widths retained. Incoming: Loan B, Priority C, Lender D:E, Funding date F:G, Amount H:J, Accrued interest K:L, Funding M:N, Repayment projection O:P. Outgoing: Loan B:C, Debtor D:E, Funding date F:G, Amount H:J, Accrued interest K:L, Funding M:N. Incoming ends at P; outgoing ends at N. Daily accrued-interest totals and dated explanatory footers are included. See 2026-11-13-loan-funding-dates-accrued-interest.json for formulas and validation.
